sources.title: Crazy Tube Circuits Black Magic MkII | AllThePedals
sources.excerpt: The Crazy Tube Circuits Black Magic MkII is a high-gain distortion pedal for electric guitar, designed to emulate the sound and feel of a high-gain tube amplifier. Using JFET technology and cascaded gain stages, it offers a versatile range from classic rock distortion to heavy metal tones, making it a great choice for stoner rock and metal. Features a 3-band EQ and presence control for sound shaping, plus a boost footswitch for solos. It cleans up with the guitar's volume knob, and is similar to the Marshall BluesBreaker . Black Magic mkII — Crazy Tube Circuits Distortion Pedal | PedalFilter | PedalFilter
sources.excerpt: Distortion JFET high-gain monster nailing American and British amp tones with a killer 3-band EQ. The Black Magic mkII uses cascaded JFET gain stages to replicate the signal path and feel of high-gain tube amplifiers. It blends American and British voicings into a single circuit, covering everything from low overdrive to fully saturated distortion with massive sustain. Even at maximum gain, it preserves clarity and cleans up naturally with the guitar's volume knob. Controls include Gain, Volume, a 3-band passive EQ (Bass, Mids, Treble), and a Presence knob. A dedicated boost footswitch is assignable to boost gain, volume, or both simultaneously for solos. True bypass. Handmade in Athens, Greece. Runs on 9V DC, center-negative. sources.title: Crazy Tube Circuits Black Magic MKII – Davis Guitar
sources.excerpt: Crazy Tube Circuits Black Magic MKII $250.00 Utilizing JFET technology cascaded gain stages we set out to mimic the signal path and response of a high gain tube amp. Combining the best sounds of American and British style high gain amps along with a versatile 3 band passive EQ and presence control we created a distortion effect that can cover a wide range of gain from low overdrive – crunchy sounds to fully saturated gain with huge amounts of sustain. Even at high gain settings Black Magic mk2 preserves full clarity and definition and can clean up with your guitar’s volume knob. With an assignable boost footswitch you can select to boost gain, volume or both in order to stand out for your solo without the need to change settings on the fly.
